title: Phase C audit R1 — five independent-audit findings closed on top of unified LLM planning
description: Audit R1 closure for PR #112 (BASE staging/pr59-safe@69d1c9b). F1: all win32 TOLERATED_FAILURES entries carry platform:"win32"; run.mjs budget filters by process.platform so Windows baselines are inert on Linux and can never mask a real failure there. F2: business.ts extracts openEligibilityRow — the IDENTICAL eligibility/dedup gate openWorkItem enforces — and prepareDelegatedPlan runs it BEFORE deps.planExpander, so no paid provider call is spent on an item that cannot open; objective-operating-loop converges AWAITING_EXECUTION when a race loser finds a bound in-flight mission at either the preflight throw or the open dedup (canonical proof, not string matching). F3: PlannerInvocation gains ONE absolute run deadlineMs threaded from runPlannerFailover into INITIAL and REASK invocations; llm-planner's internal retry loop min()s every request timeout against it and can never START a request at/after the deadline — lapsed deadline yields zero provider requests with typed warning. F4: planner cost settlement keys on provider_requests — transport-reported requests that PROVABLY initiated (HTTP fetch / codex spawn / codex qualification probe), threaded as a mutable per-attempt counter through assertEligible and planFn, stamped on the settled attempt row, persisted on planner_attempt, and atomically aggregated onto planner_run; cost.ts settle+reconcile use run.provider_requests, never the STARTED-attempt count, so eligibility-rejected attempts settle RELEASED. F5: objective-auto-driver computes planning_deadline_epoch_ms = lease.started_at + lease.max_lifetime_ms - 60s finalization allowance and passes it through runObjectivePass/openDelegatedChild/prepareDelegatedPlan as expandCtx.deadlineMs, so delegated planning can never outlive the invoking lease. No Phase C R3 semantics changed; Telegram HOTFIX A-D untouched; tests: 18-case regression file pair-phase-c-audit-r1.test.ts.
